Notice for opening Financial Bid

With reference to our tender notice of even no. dated 09th August, 2016, financial bid will be opened on 26.10.2016 at 15:30 hrs in R.S. Iyer Hall, IPC, Ghaziabad for Designing & Development of IPC Web Portal with e-commerce facility.
